description: This file defines a wizard for tracking production moves in an Odoo (OpenERP) module, including form handling and move splitting logic.

classes.name: wizard_track_move
classes.description: Wizard interface class for tracking and splitting production moves.

methods.name: _get_moves
methods.description: Generates XML form for selecting production move lines to track.

methods.name: _track_lines
methods.description: Creates lots and updates move lines based on tracking selections.

methods.name: _next
methods.description: Determines the next state of the wizard based on production state.
